game.title: Code Vein
game.blurb: Action RPG of revenants, blood codes and Gifts, from Bandai Namco Entertainment, released 2019-09-26. RAWG average playtime: 7 hours. Genres: Action, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: The bosses in order of the places they guard, from the ruined city to the Gaol of the Stagnant Blood.

chapters.title: Companions and Memories
chapters.summary: Memory echoes, restoring Vestiges, partner conversations, presents and companion reputation.

chapters.title: Exploration
chapters.summary: Mistles and exploring every part of the depths.

chapters.title: Gifts, Blood Codes and Gear
chapters.summary: Learning Gifts, blood codes, weapons, Blood Veils, upgrades and drain attacks.

chapters.title: Endings and Completion
chapters.summary: The three endings, seeing them all, and every achievement. Spoiler-guarded.

notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). No StrategyWiki page under "Code Vein" or "CODE VEIN". codevein.fandom.com answers the API, with about 46 linked pages; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema calls the app "Vena Cava" (an internal codename); the store list confirms app 678960. None of the 43 Steam achievements are hidden. The boss achievements name the place of each fight, so the main story chapter lists them in schema order; the ending names are visible in the Steam list, so the endings chapter should stay spoiler-guarded.
